title: Understanding and Tackling Label Errors in Individual-Level Nature Language Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2502.13297v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Natural language understanding (NLU) is a task that enables machines to understand human language. Some tasks, such as stance detection and sentiment analysis, are closely related to individual subjective perspectives, thus termed individual-level NLU. Previously, these tasks are often simplified to text-level NLU tasks, ignoring individual factors. This not only makes inference difficult and unexplainable but often results in a large number of label errors when creating datasets. To address the above limitations, we propose a new NLU annotation guideline based on individual-level factors. Specifically, we incorporate other posts by the same individual and then annotate individual subjective perspectives after considering all individual posts. We use this guideline to expand and re-annotate the stance detection and topic-based sentiment analysis datasets. We find that error rates in the samples were as high as 31.7\% and 23.3\%

translated_title: 理解并解决个体级自然语言理解中的标签错误
translated_abstract: 自然语言理解（NLU）是使机器能够理解人类语言的任务。一些任务，如立场检测和情感分析，与个体的主观视角密切相关，因此被称为个体级NLU。以往这些任务通常被简化为文本级NLU任务，忽略了个体因素。这不仅使推理变得困难且缺乏可解释性，而且在构建数据集时往往导致大量的标签错误。为了解决上述局限性，我们提出了一种基于个体级因素的新NLU标注指南。具体而言，我们纳入同一个体的其他帖子，并在综合考虑该个体的所有帖子后对其主观视角进行标注。我们使用该指南扩展并重新标注了立场检测和基于主题的情感分析数据集。我们发现样本中的错误率分别高达31.7%和23.3%。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于个体级因素的NLU标注指南，通过纳入同一个体的所有帖子来重新标注立场检测和情感分析数据集，并揭示了现有数据集中高达31.7%和23.3%的标签错误率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a new NLU annotation guideline based on individual-level factors, re-annotating stance detection and sentiment analysis datasets by considering all posts from the same individual, revealing label error rates as high as 31.7% and 23.3% in existing datasets.
